What Scale AI sells

Provides expert training data and AI testing. It also builds AI applications for businesses and governments.

  • Scale Data Engine — Training data and annotation (labels added to data so models can learn).
  • Scale GenAI Portfolio — AI applications for work inside businesses.
  • Scale Donovan — AI applications for government users.
